name: sync-repair
goal: Fix the broken Patchlane sync safely and leave a validated local repair ready for review.
preferences: Remove the obsolete upstream workflow from the repaired patch.
Show the isolated repair candidate before changing the configured patch ref.

authorization.description: Create, inspect, and validate an isolated repair candidate.
Project the validated repair onto only the local configured failing patch ref.

prohibitions: Do not change the configured patch ref before projection approval.
Do not push or rewrite the remote patch ref.
